answer.text: Inference from code: An empty TR attribute or a value such as auto parses to None, then HRF generation reads stimulus.Header['pixdim'][4]. The parser accepts unsigned decimal strings as floats, but treats scientific notation, negatives and other non-digit forms as None. Omitting the TR attribute entirely can instead fail on dictionary lookup; this is not a measured-fMRI-header fallback. answer.text:
Inference from code: The native file does not need to have this height: scipy.ndimage.zoom resamples spatial axes with order=1 to the configured (height, width), retaining the original time count. The code does not force height and width to be equal. [source 1](https://github.com/siddmittal/GEMpRF/blob/c35f9fddbca98df24af24ee478b7f843b02a3f81/gem/run/run_gem_prf_analysis.py#L120-L120) [source 2](https://github.com/siddmittal/GEMpRF/blob/c35f9fddbca98df24af24ee478b7f843b02a3f81/gem/model/prf_stimulus.py#L102-L111)

Inference from code: There is no explicit width==height validator, but the current signal code assigns stimulus.data_shape() to stim_width,stim_height,stim_frames, whereas resampling constructs (height,width,T). It then passes these reversed dimension names to a kernel that indexes y by rows and x by columns. Unequal dimensions can therefore misindex coordinates; this revision does not establish reliable rectangular-stimulus support. [source 1](https://github.com/siddmittal/GEMpRF/blob/c35f9fddbca98df24af24ee478b7f843b02a3f81/gem/run/run_gem_prf_analysis.py#L120-L120) [source 2](https://github.com/siddmittal/GEMpRF/blob/c35f9fddbca98df24af24ee478b7f843b02a3f81/gem/signals/signal_synthesizer.py#L149-L152) [source 3](https://github.com/siddmittal/GEMpRF/blob/c35f9fddbca98df24af24ee478b7f843b02a3f81/gem/signals/signal_synthesizer.py#L201-L210) [source 4](https://github.com/siddmittal/GEMpRF/blob/c35f9fddbca98df24af24ee478b7f843b02a3f81/gem/kernels/gaussian_kernel.cu#L49-L60)

answer.text: Code: nDCT is an integer controlling the cosine trend basis: frequencies 0,0.5,...,nDCT give 2*nDCT+1 regressors for nonnegative integer nDCT. answer.text: Inference from code: The unmasked grid has horizontal_count × vertical_count spatial points, each expanded by every sigma value. answer.text: Inference from code: For positive radius and n>1, an odd num_vertical_prfs includes zero on that axis because linspace is symmetric. Both counts odd give a centre at (0,0), which passes the radial mask for positive radius. Odd counts are not enforced by the loader. conditions.source_question: What must the custom parameters file contain?
required_limitations: Only actively loaded child datasets are required by the routing, but malformed supplied default attributes can still fail configuration parsing.

answer.text:
Code: The custom filepath is passed directly to H5FileManager, which opens it with h5py.File(filepath, "r") and returns f[key][()]. It must identify an accessible HDF5 file containing the datasets selected by active child flags. [source 1](https://github.com/siddmittal/GEMpRF/blob/c35f9fddbca98df24af24ee478b7f843b02a3f81/gem/configs/config_manager.py#L123-L136) [source 2](https://github.com/siddmittal/GEMpRF/blob/c35f9fddbca98df24af24ee478b7f843b02a3f81/gem/utils/gem_h5_file_handler.py#L18-L24) [source 3](https://github.com/siddmittal/GEMpRF/blob/c35f9fddbca98df24af24ee478b7f843b02a3f81/gem/run/run_gem_prf_analysis.py#L63-L67) [source 4](https://github.com/siddmittal/GEMpRF/blob/c35f9fddbca98df24af24ee478b7f843b02a3f81/gem/run/run_gem_prf_analysis.py#L138-L142) [source 5](https://github.com/siddmittal/GEMpRF/blob/c35f9fddbca98df24af24ee478b7f843b02a3f81/gem/init_setup.py#L90-L96)

Inference from code: Supply a one-dimensional numeric HRF sample array. The HDF5 reader returns its dataset directly, and convolution indexes hrf_curve[None,:] against pixel timecourses; it does not flatten or validate a multidimensional HRF first. Loaded HRF values are not processed by default_hrf normalization. [source 1](https://github.com/siddmittal/GEMpRF/blob/c35f9fddbca98df24af24ee478b7f843b02a3f81/gem/utils/gem_h5_file_handler.py#L18-L24) [source 2](https://github.com/siddmittal/GEMpRF/blob/c35f9fddbca98df24af24ee478b7f843b02a3f81/gem/run/run_gem_prf_analysis.py#L62-L89) [source 3](https://github.com/siddmittal/GEMpRF/blob/c35f9fddbca98df24af24ee478b7f843b02a3f81/gem/model/prf_stimulus.py#L124-L134)

Inference from code: Supply a one-dimensional numeric vector of sigma values. It is returned unchanged by the HDF5 reader and used as an extra dimension: the grid code takes its length and assigns individual entries as scalar sigma coordinates. There is no flattening, sorting, or positivity validation in this load path. conditions.source_question: What is the difference between grid fit and refine fit?

answer.text: Inference from code: Grid fitting selects the candidate with the largest projection YᵀS′. Refinement uses neighbouring error/derivative values and coefficient matrices to build a local quadratic and solves pinv(2A)·(-B). This is not an iterative generic optimizer, and this solver does not clamp final parameters to min/max sigma or the grid extent. [source 1](https://github.com/siddmittal/GEMpRF/blob/c35f9fddbca98df24af24ee478b7f843b02a3f81/gem/fitting/hpc_grid_fit.py#L18-L20) [source 2](https://github.com/siddmittal/GEMpRF/blob/c35f9fddbca98df24af24ee478b7f843b02a3f81/gem/fitting/hpc_grid_fit.py#L143-L163) [source 3](https://github.com/siddmittal/GEMpRF/blob/c35f9fddbca98df24af24ee478b7f843b02a3f81/gem/fitting/hpc_refine_fit.py#L85-L105)

answer.text:
Inference from code: Supply a one-dimensional numeric vector of sigma values. It is returned unchanged by the HDF5 reader and used as an extra dimension: the grid code takes its length and assigns individual entries as scalar sigma coordinates. There is no flattening, sorting, or positivity validation in this load path. [source 1](https://github.com/siddmittal/GEMpRF/blob/c35f9fddbca98df24af24ee478b7f843b02a3f81/gem/utils/gem_h5_file_handler.py#L18-L24) [source 2](https://github.com/siddmittal/GEMpRF/blob/c35f9fddbca98df24af24ee478b7f843b02a3f81/gem/run/run_gem_prf_analysis.py#L136-L146) [source 3](https://github.com/siddmittal/GEMpRF/blob/c35f9fddbca98df24af24ee478b7f843b02a3f81/gem/space/PRFSpace.py#L354-L374) [source 4](https://github.com/siddmittal/GEMpRF/blob/c35f9fddbca98df24af24ee478b7f843b02a3f81/gem/model/prf_gaussian_model.py#L69-L72)

required_limitations: Custom-grid radial filtering uses the largest coordinate, not the largest absolute coordinate or Euclidean radius.

answer.text:
Inference from code: The file-loaded array is passed directly to PRFSpace, which builds a KDTree from the supplied points; it is not forced onto a regular mesh. Irregular centres can therefore be used, subject to the radial candidate mask and the neighbouring-point geometry needed for refinement. [source 1](https://github.com/siddmittal/GEMpRF/blob/c35f9fddbca98df24af24ee478b7f843b02a3f81/gem/init_setup.py#L90-L96) [source 2](https://github.com/siddmittal/GEMpRF/blob/c35f9fddbca98df24af24ee478b7f843b02a3f81/gem/init_setup.py#L138-L140) [source 3](https://github.com/siddmittal/GEMpRF/blob/c35f9fddbca98df24af24ee478b7f843b02a3f81/gem/space/PRFSpace.py#L252-L259) [source 4](https://github.com/siddmittal/GEMpRF/blob/c35f9fddbca98df24af24ee478b7f843b02a3f81/gem/space/PRFSpace.py#L399-L408) [source 5](https://github.com/siddmittal/GEMpRF/blob/c35f9fddbca98df24af24ee478b7f843b02a3f81/gem/model/prf_gaussian_model.py#L69-L72)

[source 1](https://github.com/siddmittal/GEMpRF/blob/c35f9fddbca98df24af24ee478b7f843b02a3f81/gem/run/run_gem_prf_analysis.py#L199-L200) [source 2](https://github.com/siddmittal/GEMpRF/blob/c35f9fddbca98df24af24ee478b7f843b02a3f81/gem/data/bids_handler.py#L154-L164) [source 3](https://github.com/siddmittal/GEMpRF/blob/c35f9fddbca98df24af24ee478b7f843b02a3f81/gem/data/bids_handler.py#L175-L178) [source 4](https://github.com/siddmittal/GEMpRF/blob/c35f9fddbca98df24af24ee478b7f843b02a3f81/gem/data/bids_handler.py#L35-L41)

Inference from code: Use a stimulus basename containing task-<exact task label>, for example task-bar_apertures.nii.gz. BIDS selection compares the parsed task label exactly, scans only .nii.gz files, and chooses the first match; there is no ambiguity check for multiple matching stimuli. [source 1](https://github.com/siddmittal/GEMpRF/blob/c35f9fddbca98df24af24ee478b7f843b02a3f81/gem/data/bids_handler.py#L24-L31) [source 2](https://github.com/siddmittal/GEMpRF/blob/c35f9fddbca98df24af24ee478b7f843b02a3f81/gem/data/bids_handler.py#L35-L41) [source 3](https://github.com/siddmittal/GEMpRF/blob/c35f9fddbca98df24af24ee478b7f843b02a3f81/gem/data/bids_handler.py#L175-L178)

Inference from code: The sample specifies NIfTI stimulus input, and BIDS discovery accepts .nii.gz. evidence.text: when write_debug_info is enabled, and where

answer.text:
Code: search_space/write_debug_info is parsed case-insensitively, with a runtime fallback of false. It initializes the debug writer; when false, write_array_to_h5 returns before opening a file. When true, arrays are written under the setup result directory to debug_model_data.h5. [source 1](https://github.com/siddmittal/GEMpRF/blob/c35f9fddbca98df24af24ee478b7f843b02a3f81/gem/configs/config_manager.py#L97-L101) [source 2](https://github.com/siddmittal/GEMpRF/blob/c35f9fddbca98df24af24ee478b7f843b02a3f81/gem/init_setup.py#L143-L144) [source 3](https://github.com/siddmittal/GEMpRF/blob/c35f9fddbca98df24af24ee478b7f843b02a3f81/gem/utils/gem_write_to_file.py#L36-L46)

Code: Debug calls write the candidate pRF grid, HRF, resampled and HRF-convolved stimuli, orthogonalization matrices, raw and normalized model signals, and enabled derivative signals. Individual analysis also writes the measured-data path list. Task-specific arrays use task subgroups; HRF uses a shared hrf key that can be replaced. [source 1](https://github.com/siddmittal/GEMpRF/blob/c35f9fddbca98df24af24ee478b7f843b02a3f81/gem/init_setup.py#L143-L144) [source 2](https://github.com/siddmittal/GEMpRF/blob/c35f9fddbca98df24af24ee478b7f843b02a3f81/gem/run/run_gem_prf_analysis.py#L116-L123) [source 3](https://github.com/siddmittal/GEMpRF/blob/c35f9fddbca98df24af24ee478b7f843b02a3f81/gem/run/run_gem_prf_analysis.py#L174-L192) [source 4](https://github.com/siddmittal/GEMpRF/blob/c35f9fddbca98df24af24ee478b7f843b02a3f81/gem/run/run_gem_prf_analysis.py#L606-L606) [source 5](https://github.com/siddmittal/GEMpRF/blob/c35f9fddbca98df24af24ee478b7f843b02a3f81/gem/run/run_gem_prf_analysis.py#L621-L625) [source 6](https://github.com/siddmittal/GEMpRF/blob/c35f9fddbca98df24af24ee478b7f843b02a3f81/gem/run/run_gem_prf_analysis.py#L419-L424) [source 7](https://github.com/siddmittal/GEMpRF/blob/c35f9fddbca98df24af24ee478b7f843b02a3f81/gem/utils/gem_write_to_file.py#L98-L123)

answer.text:
Insufficient evidence: the requested proof or external procedure is not established by the checked pinned implementation. The supported code behavior and specific gap follow.

Inference from code: Debug output can copy GPU arrays to CPU, concatenate arrays and write HDF5 datasets, so it adds work and storage. The source provides no measured slowdown factor; the cost depends on the arrays and storage system. [source 1](https://github.com/siddmittal/GEMpRF/blob/c35f9fddbca98df24af24ee478b7f843b02a3f81/gem/utils/gem_write_to_file.py#L54-L91) [source 2](https://github.com/siddmittal/GEMpRF/blob/c35f9fddbca98df24af24ee478b7f843b02a3f81/gem/utils/gem_write_to_file.py#L98-L123)

Limitation: The writer establishes extra copy/concatenation/I/O operations, but no measured slowdown is supplied.

tools.name: explain_purpose
tools.description: Explain the documented purpose of one GEM-pRF parameter. This describes the parameter, not the user's current setting.

tools.name: explain_code_usage
tools.description: Explain where one GEM-pRF parameter is used in the documented source code, with the original source citations.

tools.name: get_default_value
tools.description: Return the documented default of one GEM-pRF parameter. A documented default is not evidence of the user's current setting.

tools.name: explain_change_effect
tools.description: Explain the documented effect of increasing or decreasing a parameter, including source assumptions and limitations. Does not change configuration or evaluate an arbitrary numeric value. For default_hrf.t, this function returns only the documented conditional explanation of a stop-endpoint change with start and positive effective TR held fixed. Use it only when those conditions are supplied in the question or actual history, or when that conditional explanation is explicitly requested. For an intended change with an unspecified endpoint or unspecified start-held-fixed, TR-held-fixed or TR-positive facts, use explain_hrf_interval_change_effect and retain every missing fact for clarification; do not assume those conditions.

tools.name: explain_boolean_effect
tools.description: Explain setting a case-insensitively parsed GEM-pRF flag to true or false. This is a semantic boolean setting, not arbitrary raw-string interpretation.

value.description: Requested true/false setting; only case-insensitive source parsers are admitted.

tools.name: explain_flag_literal_effect
tools.description: Explain an exact XML flag literal where source code is case-sensitive. Do not rewrite true or TRUE as True.

value.description: Exact requested XML literal. Case is material.

tools.name: get_units
tools.description: Explain the documented units of a parameter, preserving the source coordinate/time scale and interval qualifications.

tools.name: get_custom_component_units
tools.description: Explain the units of values in a custom sigma or spatial-grid array loaded from a file; not the units of its enable flag.

component.description: Scientific component whose file-array values are requested.

tools.name: explain_case_sensitivity
tools.description: Explain whether a parameter value or key is matched case-sensitively. This reports the documented rule; it does not inspect user files or test an arbitrary supplied value.

subject.description: Parameter or key whose case-sensitivity property is requested.

tools.name: compare_parameters
tools.description: Explain the general functional distinction between a specifically documented parameter pair as one joint answer. Left/right order is preserved; numerical, performance or accuracy comparisons require separate contracts.

tools.name: explain_conditional_applicability
tools.description: Explain whether one requested parameter is used when a distinct flag is enabled or disabled. Keep the requested subject separate from the condition participant. The boolean denotes actual enabled/disabled state, not an arbitrary XML spelling.

condition_subject.description: Flag supplying the condition, not an additional requested subject.

condition_value.description: True for enabled, false for disabled. Preserve negation/polarity; do not normalize case-sensitive raw literals into states without justification.

tools.name: explain_sigma_default_applicability
tools.description: Explain jointly whether num_sigmas, min_sigma and max_sigma generate values when custom sigma loading is enabled. Preserve an explicitly supplied order of these three requested fields. Omit an unstated optional parent and retain the source both-flags qualification.

optional_parameters_enabled.description: Include only when the query explicitly also states the optional parent flag is enabled; otherwise omit.

requested_subjects.description: All three jointly requested fields in caller order, for later ordinal references. Omit only when using the existing canonical order; never distribute this joint applicability question.

items.description: One jointly requested default sigma parameter.

sigma_file_enabled.description: The query states sigmas.use_from_file is enabled.

tools.name: get_value_guidance
tools.description: Explain how to choose a parameter value, including requests for an ideal value. This is source-grounded selection guidance, not the current setting, a substitute default, a personal numeric prescription or validation of a supplied value. Include optional context only when the query states it.

preprocessing.description: Explicit preprocessing software, only when stated.

gpu_out_of_memory.description: The query explicitly supplies a GPU out-of-memory scenario, reported or hypothetical; never infer actual device state.

run_labels_present.description: The query explicitly states run labels are absent.

refinement_enabled.description: Explicit refinement enabled/disabled condition, not an additional requested parameter.

individualize.description: The question explicitly asks whether to vary the parameter across subjects or brain regions.

slice_time_corrected.description: The query explicitly states slice-time correction; a software example does not establish a specific package.

tools.name: get_enable_guidance
tools.description: Explain when to enable or disable a feature or choose its alternate path. Does not assume current flags, apply a setting, validate arbitrary literal case, or claim a universal scientific improvement.

data_format.description: Explicit non-BIDS input layout; omit when unstated.

tools.name: get_allowed_values
tools.description: Explain a parameter value domain or range from the pinned implementation. Preserve differences between parser acceptance, fallthrough behavior and scientifically meaningful values.

subject.description: Parameter whose allowed values or range are requested.

tools.name: explain_value_form_acceptance
tools.description: Explain whether a specified value form or array geometry is admitted. This is a form-level question, not a concrete-value validation or an enable-flag effect.

subject.description: Requested parameter or scientific array object.

form.description: Requested numeric form or spatial-point spacing property.

tools.name: explain_item_count_limits
tools.description: Explain the documented lower or upper count limit for repeated configuration items, retaining parsed-structure caveats.

tools.name: explain_value_acceptance
tools.description: Explain a specifically documented supplied value: exact task literal all, zero min_sigma or one num_sigmas. It does not generalize to other values, arbitrary XML spellings or a scientific validity guarantee.

subject.description: Parameter whose supplied value is requested.

value.description: Exact case-sensitive task string, or stated numerical zero/one case. Arbitrary raw numeric spellings are not accepted here.

tools.name: explain_default_rationale
tools.description: Return source evidence and explicit evidence gaps about the rationale/origin of a documented default. Never infer author intent or scientific calibration from a sample value or formula.

subject.description: Parameter whose documented default origin is requested.

tools.name: explain_grid_density_guidance
tools.description: Explain whole-search grid-density choices under an explicitly enabled or disabled refinement condition. Preserve coarse sampling, dependence of refinement on its initial grid and the absence of a numerical sufficiency guarantee.

refinement_enabled.description: Explicit refinement enabled/disabled condition, not a request for that flag.

tools.name: explain_value_relation
tools.description: Explain whether a requested parameter should satisfy a stated directional relation to a distinct reference parameter; no numeric values are assumed or compared.

reference.description: Reference parameter, not another requested subject.

tools.name: describe_path_target
tools.description: Describe required target contents or file-versus-directory kind for a configured path. Does not inspect a user path.

aspect.description: Whether the question asks what belongs at the path or whether it must be a file or directory.

tools.name: explain_path_portability
tools.description: Explain both relative-path resolution and Windows-path portability for a configured path; no assertion that a supplied path exists.

tools.name: explain_path_failure
tools.description: Explain the documented hypothetical missing/invalid-path behavior, including skip, return, exception and no-silent-fallback distinctions.

subject.description: Path or ordered path-component setting whose failure is requested.

problem.description: Missing only versus the source question covering absence or an unsuitable target. This is not a real filesystem observation.

tools.name: explain_bids_search_path
tools.description: Explain how the BIDS input search root and ordered appended components form the search path, including the documented layout example.

components.description: Ordered component sequence role; not alternative input roots.

tools.name: explain_repeated_gpu_selection
tools.description: Explain what happens when the selected default GPU is also present in the additional GPU list.

additional_list.description: List in which the same selected device is repeated.

tools.name: explain_gpu_visibility_mapping
tools.description: Explain configured default-device ordering and CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES remapping, including fallback behavior.

environment_variable.description: Visibility mapping whose relationship is requested.

tools.name: explain_hrf_sampling_relationship
tools.description: Explain how the HRF interval and sampling step jointly determine generated samples, without choosing an ideal scientific interval.

step.description: Related sampling step, not a second independent units/default question.

tools.name: explain_sigma_extent_relationship
tools.description: Explain how a sigma endpoint relates to the stimulus coordinate extent; do not derive an optimal range or impose a bound.

tools.name: explain_grid_axis_geometry
tools.description: Explain default grid-axis spacing or inclusion of zero for the selected grid-count parameter. Not a custom-grid calculator.

property.description: Requested geometric property: nominal spacing or odd-count inclusion of zero.

tools.name: explain_discovery_filter_relationship
tools.description: Explain how filename-entity and file-format discovery filters interact, without imposing an unimplemented fixed mapping.

format_filter.description: Related suffix filter; .gii and .nii.gz are illustrative domains.

tools.name: explain_parameter_ordering
tools.description: Explain whether one named parameter must exceed another, keeping validation distinct from scientific modelling preference.

reference.description: Reference delay, not a second independent request.

tools.name: explain_parameter_equality
tools.description: Explain whether two requested parameters must be equal as one joint requirement, preserving caller left/right order and source implementation limitations.

tools.name: explain_parameter_data_matching
tools.description: Explain whether a configured parameter must match a named property of the stimulus or measured data; no numerical or user-file validation.

reference.description: Actual data property against which matching is asked, not a source-question identifier.

tools.name: explain_run_timepoint_equality
tools.description: Explain whether all runs in concatenated fitting must have equal lengths, retaining each run/model compatibility requirements.

run_type.description: The requested run group, not a configuration update.

tools.name: explain_stimulus_timepoint_matching
tools.description: Explain a stimulus-frame count relation to measured timepoints or a downsampling target. Keeps original versus downsampled time grids separate.

reference.description: Count on the right side of the relation.

tools.name: explain_measured_file_stimulus_requirement
tools.description: Explain whether the fixed-path measured-file list shares a stimulus, preserving the branch scope.

tools.name: explain_stimulus_file_reuse
tools.description: Explain whether one fixed stimulus file can be used for multiple measured files, preserving source branch scope.

tools.name: compare_data_formats
tools.description: Compare measured-image loading for two named file formats, not a full external format specification.

tools.name: compare_fitting_methods
tools.description: Compare coarse grid selection with local refinement as one algorithmic distinction, not a claim of better accuracy.

tools.name: compare_refinement_backend_results
tools.description: Report evidence and limitations about equivalence of CPU and GPU refinement results. Do not claim equivalence without validation.

tools.name: compare_run_modes
tools.description: Compare individual and concatenated run semantics, including separate versus shared fitting, without an accuracy guarantee.

tools.name: explain_section_applicability
tools.description: Explain whether a configuration section is used under a declared mode, preserving loading-versus-execution distinctions.

section.description: Requested configuration section, not one of its child parameters.

bids_enabled.description: Explicit enabled BIDS state; never infer it from an incorrectly cased raw literal.

tools.name: explain_execution_hardware_requirement
tools.description: Explain whether the normal GEM-pRF analysis can run in the hypothetical absence of a GPU; no hardware probe is performed.

gpu_available.description: The explicitly requested no-GPU scenario, not an observation about this computer.

tools.name: explain_hemisphere_filter_applicability
tools.description: Explain whether hemisphere filtering applies to a specified measured-file representation.

file_extension.description: Explicit volumetric representation in the question; not an independent requested parameter.

tools.name: explain_required_temporal_settings
tools.description: Explain which additional configuration values and time-length constraints are needed with high temporal resolution enabled.

high_temporal_resolution_enabled.description: Explicit condition; not a request for the enable flag itself.

tools.name: explain_default_component_applicability
tools.description: Explain whether a default HRF or spatial-grid group is bypassed under an explicitly enabled or disabled custom-loading child flag. Omit unstated parent context and keep the both-flags condition.

component_file_enabled.description: Explicit state of the corresponding child use_from_file flag. False selects the default branch regardless of an unstated parent; never infer the parent.

optional_parameters_enabled.description: Only include if the parent flag is explicitly known enabled; omit for unknown.

tools.name: explain_all_default_groups_applicability
tools.description: Explain jointly whether default_hrf, default_sigmas and default_spatial_grid are ignored under an explicitly supplied optional-parent state; child flags remain unspecified.

optional_parameters_enabled.description: Explicit parent flag state; never infer child flags.

tools.name: explain_partial_custom_loading
tools.description: Explain the ability to load a subset of HRF/sigma/spatial-grid components while generating others. An illustrative only-sigmas example is not a supplied configuration.

tools.name: explain_outside_stimulus_candidates
tools.description: Explain whether candidate pRF centres outside the stimulated coordinate area can be compared, retaining the distinction from identifiable or accurate estimation.

tools.name: describe_parameter_result_location
tools.description: Describe the sourced result-path pattern relative to a named BIDS path or analysis identifier, without constructing a path from user-specific values.

subject.description: Parameter relative to which the result location is requested.

tools.name: describe_results_when_bids_enabled
tools.description: Describe the documented result location under enabled BIDS mode; retain the individual-analysis scope of the path pattern.

bids_enabled.description: Explicit enabled mode; not an inferred raw-string interpretation.

tools.name: describe_result_backup
tools.description: Explain both backup location and naming when overwrite is disabled, preserving the existing-directory condition.

overwrite.description: Explicit disabled overwrite state; source uses case-insensitive comparison to false.

tools.name: describe_debug_output
tools.description: Explain both debug information and its output location under the explicitly supplied debug-writing state. When disabled the writer returns before file opening; retain the conditional description of enabled outputs.

debug_enabled.description: Explicit debug-writing condition; false does not assert an actual file was deleted or inspected.

tools.name: get_configuration_location
tools.description: Describe the exact XML location of a parameter; retain revision-specific example versus general equality-rule distinctions.

tools.name: explain_timing_correctness
tools.description: Explain a requested incorrect timing parameter, optionally relative to an explicitly named reference quantity. Describes the requested scenario, not inferred actual values.

reference.description: Reference quantity, included only when the question supplies it.

correct.description: The requested parameter value is wrong, not a correct-value case.

tools.name: explain_result_impact
tools.description: Explain a parameter impact on numerical estimates, parameter accuracy or output-file preservation, retaining limits of the available evidence.

outcome.description: The outcome about which an effect is requested.

value.description: Explicitly requested run_type setting; never infer an actual configuration value.

tools.name: explain_batch_count_relation
tools.description: Explain batching when the requested batch count exceeds the measured signal count; retain the different individual and concatenated paths.

relation_to_signal_count.description: Requested batch-count relation to the number of voxels or vertices, not to the timepoint count.

tools.name: explain_gpu_id_requirement
tools.description: Explain failure of an explicitly named default-GPU identifier requirement and the implemented setup fallback.

requirement.description: Which GPU identifier requirement is violated.

satisfied.description: The requested case violates the requirement.

tools.name: explain_dataset_presence
tools.description: Explain a missing requested dataset key in the custom HDF5 file, without inventing its contents or asserting an actual inspection.

component.description: Scientific component whose requested dataset is absent.

present.description: The requested key does not exist in the file.

tools.name: explain_gpu_out_of_memory
tools.description: Explain a requested GPU-memory exhaustion scenario under an explicitly selected GPU or CPU refinement backend. CPU refinement does not remove other GPU allocations; no automatic recovery or configuration change is claimed.

refinement_on_gpu.description: Explicit refinement-backend condition. False means the refinement computations use the CPU, not that the complete analysis is CPU-only.

tools.name: explain_file_preservation
tools.description: Explain whether old result files are preserved under the explicitly supplied overwrite condition, retaining directory-versus-file distinctions.

overwrite_enabled.description: Required overwrite condition; not a mutation of actual configuration.

tools.name: explain_unset_value
tools.description: Explain an empty value or an omitted configuration attribute; do not conflate an empty string, an absent attribute and a missing dataset.

subject.description: Configuration field with an empty or omitted value.

value_state.description: Explicit distinction between empty value and omitted attribute.

available_gpu_count.description: One available GPU, only when explicitly part of the requested scenario.

tools.name: explain_multiple_items
tools.description: Explain whether and how the named configuration field supports multiple items, preserving field-specific list semantics and restrictions.

subject.description: The field for which multiple items are requested.

tools.name: explain_concatenation_variation
tools.description: Explain whether concatenation blocks may vary in the requested task/session fields, retaining positional pairing and compatible signal-order requirements.

fields.description: Fields whose variation between concatenation blocks is requested.

tools.name: explain_resource_impact
tools.description: Explain requested runtime and/or memory consequences, retaining source assumptions and the absence of quantitative measurements where applicable.

runtime.description: Whether runtime consequences are requested; both booleans are true when both dimensions were requested.

tools.name: explain_debug_overhead
tools.description: Explain analysis overhead under an explicitly enabled debug-output condition; retain the absence of a measured slowdown.

debug_enabled.description: Debug output enabled is a condition, not a newly requested parameter.

tools.name: interpret_parameter_literals
tools.description: Explain the exact requested configuration literal or ordered literal group. Strings preserve spelling, case and numeric lexemes; quoting punctuation around a cited value is not part of that value.

subject.description: Parameter whose exact literal values are requested.

literals.description: Exact literal strings in the requested order; do not parse numeric strings or normalize case.

tools.name: compare_label_literals
tools.description: Compare the exact two requested label spellings, preserving prefixes, leading zeros and left/right order. Does not choose an actual user-specific ID.

subject.description: Configuration selector whose label spelling is questioned.

tools.name: explain_extent_convention
tools.description: Explain whether a spatial extent parameter denotes radius or diameter, retaining the coordinate convention and units.

tools.name: explain_filename_format
tools.description: Describe the requested filename example or naming convention for the named configuration field; examples are not actual user filenames.

subject.description: Field whose filename representation is requested.

tools.name: explain_component_sampling
tools.description: Explain the sampling grid required by a loaded scientific array; do not treat its enable flag as a sampled quantity.

component.description: Loaded HRF samples, not the hrf.use_from_file boolean flag.

tools.name: explain_sigma_spacing
tools.description: Explain how default sigma samples are generated from the count and ordered lower/upper bounds, without inventing numeric parameter values.

count_parameter.description: Parameter controlling generated sigma sample count; a formula participant, not a separately requested target.

lower_bound_parameter.description: Lower-bound participant; not a second requested subject.

upper_bound_parameter.description: Upper-bound participant; not a second requested subject.

tools.name: explain_item_order
tools.description: Explain the significance of ordering items in an ordered configuration sequence, preserving path-versus-concatenation semantics.

subject.description: Ordered sequence whose item order is requested.

tools.name: explain_stimulus_transformation
tools.description: Explain binarization or spatial resampling of the stimulus, keeping the particular spatial dimension when requested.

dimension.description: Spatial dimension, required only for resampling.

tools.name: explain_multi_file_handling
tools.description: Explain whether the selected multi-file source is fitted separately, averaged or together; does not configure or execute an analysis.

source.description: Source configuration of the multiple measured files.

tools.name: explain_single_task_restriction
tools.description: Explain the implementation evidence for the individual route accepting one task, retaining uncertainty about broader author intent.

tools.name: explain_result_directory
tools.description: Explain result-directory creation, or the explicitly supplied case in which it already exists. The existence argument describes the requested case, not filesystem inspection.

already_exists.description: Include only when the question supplies an already-existing-directory case.

tools.name: explain_stimulus_matching
tools.description: Explain how a measured task is matched to a stimulus input file in the specified source directory.

entity.description: The task entity used for matching.

tools.name: explain_configuration_migration
tools.description: Explain whether changing only the version label migrates an old configuration schema; no configuration is modified.

version_label_only.description: The proposed change modifies only the version label, not the field schema.

tools.name: explain_generator_editability
tools.description: Explain the available evidence for a Configuration Generator control reported as noneditable, including missing UI evidence.

control.description: Exact named UI control; not an inferred installed version.

editable.description: Noneditability is the reported case being questioned, not a result of inspecting the UI.

tools.name: explain_character_requirements
tools.description: Explain whether a filename or output-label field has character validation or sanitization, retaining filesystem limitations.

subject.description: Output text field whose allowed characters are requested.

tools.name: get_file_requirements
tools.description: Describe the required file format or required contents for the named input. Contents and format are distinct requests; retain consumer shape and routing limitations.

requirement.description: Whether the question requests file format or required contents.

tools.name: explain_version_format
tools.description: Explain the representation and exact-text equality requirements of the XML root version attribute.

subject.description: Root version attribute, not a numeric model parameter.

tools.name: explain_identifier_lookup
tools.description: Explain available evidence for finding a GPU identifier or an HDF5 dataset key; retain missing inventory/enumeration procedures.

subject.description: Identifier or key whose lookup is requested.

tools.name: explain_error_remedy
tools.description: Explain the source-backed remedy for the exact named error message, without pretending to inspect or repair user files.

enum: Number of timepoints in measured fMRI data and stimulus do not match
error_message.description: Exact quoted error label, without surrounding English quotation delimiters.

tools.name: explain_hrf_normalization
tools.description: Explain how normalization of the generated HRF is computed, including its distinction from loaded HRF arrays.

tools.name: explain_custom_file_creation
tools.description: Explain the documented pattern for constructing a custom-parameter HDF5 file; does not create a file or invent scientific arrays.

tools.name: explain_installed_version_lookup
tools.description: Explain how to inspect the installed package version; the pinned source version is not asserted to be the user environment version.

package.description: Package whose own version attribute is requested.

tools.name: explain_old_configuration_source
tools.description: Explain the available source evidence for obtaining a configuration matching an older package release, retaining missing historical-download evidence.

package.description: Package for which an older matching configuration is requested.

tools.name: get_component_shape
tools.description: Describe required shape and numeric layout for an HDF5-loaded scientific component; these components are arrays, not their use_from_file flags.

tools.name: explain_hrf_shape_effect
tools.description: Explain how the named generated-HRF parameter affects the sampled HRF shape in both change directions, preserving source assumptions and invalid-value limits.

subject.description: HRF parameter whose general shape effect is requested.

tools.name: explain_label_case_acceptance
tools.description: Explain acceptance of the exact lowercase hemisphere label pair l/r against filename entities. Preserve the requested spellings; no user file is inspected and arbitrary labels are not validated.

literals.description: The documented lowercase pair, retained as l then r; not uppercase-normalized.

tools.name: explain_default_loading_under_xml_condition
tools.description: Explain applicability of one default component group or all three default groups under an exact raw XML-text inequality on a distinct optional-loading flag. Preserve the raw comparison, keep other parent/child flags unknown, and retain the full conditional routing answer.

default_group.description: Requested default group; all_defaults is one joint request for HRF, sigma and spatial-grid defaults.

condition_subject.description: Flag whose raw XML value supplies the condition, not an additional requested subject.

operator.description: Exact raw string inequality, not an enabled/disabled predicate.

literal.description: Case-sensitive comparison operand. Do not infer enabled from not-equal False.

tools.name: explain_grid_density_under_xml_condition
tools.description: Explain whole-search grid-density guidance under an exact raw XML-text condition on refine_fitting.enable. Raw not-equal True can include both parsed flag states; retain both branches and the lack of a scientifically sufficient density threshold.

operator.description: Exact comparison on the raw refine_fitting.enable text.

literal.description: Case-sensitive raw operand; not-equal True does not imply disabled refinement.

tools.name: explain_gpu_oom_under_xml_condition

question_refs.question: What does default_hrf.t represent in GEM-pRF?

rationale: The complete existing answer contains an unconditional stop-is-excluded sentence. Preserve that historical source body exactly, then explicitly qualify its endpoint statement using the versioned primary NumPy documentation.

source_segments: Code: default_hrf/t is a pair (start,stop), parsed as floats and unpacked into arange(start,stop,TR). stop is excluded. [default x/y grid](https://github.com/siddmittal/GEMpRF/blob/c35f9fddbca98df24af24ee478b7f843b02a3f81/gem/run/run_gem_prf_analysis.py#L128-L133)

source_segments:
Code: Disabling refinement skips derivative-signal generation and the individual local-refinement and validation steps; output parameters are the chosen grid candidates. The concatenated path also returns coarse candidates, although its neighbour-matrix thread is started unconditionally. [source 1](https://github.com/siddmittal/GEMpRF/blob/c35f9fddbca98df24af24ee478b7f843b02a3f81/gem/run/run_gem_prf_analysis.py#L174-L192) [source 2](https://github.com/siddmittal/GEMpRF/blob/c35f9fddbca98df24af24ee478b7f843b02a3f81/gem/run/run_gem_prf_analysis.py#L336-L362) [source 3](https://github.com/siddmittal/GEMpRF/blob/c35f9fddbca98df24af24ee478b7f843b02a3f81/gem/run/run_gem_prf_analysis.py#L399-L402) [source 4](https://github.com/siddmittal/GEMpRF/blob/c35f9fddbca98df24af24ee478b7f843b02a3f81/gem/run/run_gem_prf_analysis.py#L523-L545)

Inference from code: Choose num_horizontal_prfs to give the x-axis spacing and candidate coverage you need within your resources. For count n>1 the spacing is 2*radius/(n-1). Without refinement, coordinate estimates come directly from the grid; with refinement the local fitting still depends on that initial grid. No ideal count is derived in this code. [source 1](https://github.com/siddmittal/GEMpRF/blob/c35f9fddbca98df24af24ee478b7f843b02a3f81/gem/run/run_gem_prf_analysis.py#L128-L133) [source 2](https://github.com/siddmittal/GEMpRF/blob/c35f9fddbca98df24af24ee478b7f843b02a3f81/gem/run/run_gem_prf_analysis.py#L336-L362) [source 3](https://github.com/siddmittal/GEMpRF/blob/c35f9fddbca98df24af24ee478b7f843b02a3f81/gem/fitting/hpc_refine_fit.py#L85-L105)

Inference from code: Choose enough sigma samples to cover the intended coarse size range at usable spacing within memory limits. Refinement uses neighbouring candidates and derivatives, but the code does not establish a minimum count that guarantees accurate refinement or an ideal number of sigmas. [source 1](https://github.com/siddmittal/GEMpRF/blob/c35f9fddbca98df24af24ee478b7f843b02a3f81/gem/run/run_gem_prf_analysis.py#L143-L144) [source 2](https://github.com/siddmittal/GEMpRF/blob/c35f9fddbca98df24af24ee478b7f843b02a3f81/gem/space/PRFSpace.py#L399-L408) [source 3](https://github.com/siddmittal/GEMpRF/blob/c35f9fddbca98df24af24ee478b7f843b02a3f81/gem/fitting/hpc_refine_fit.py#L85-L105) [source 4](https://github.com/siddmittal/GEMpRF/blob/c35f9fddbca98df24af24ee478b7f843b02a3f81/gem/signals/signal_synthesizer.py#L149-L178)

[source 1](https://github.com/siddmittal/GEMpRF/blob/c35f9fddbca98df24af24ee478b7f843b02a3f81/gem/run/run_gem_prf_analysis.py#L128-L133) [source 2](https://github.com/siddmittal/GEMpRF/blob/c35f9fddbca98df24af24ee478b7f843b02a3f81/gem/run/run_gem_prf_analysis.py#L336-L362) [source 3](https://github.com/siddmittal/GEMpRF/blob/c35f9fddbca98df24af24ee478b7f843b02a3f81/gem/fitting/hpc_refine_fit.py#L85-L105)
